correctness.rationale: Expanding the scaled T_3 polynomial gives the stated quadratic solution polynomial q_2. Its scalar values are positive on [mu,L], so q_2(A) has positive diagonal. For i!=j the exact A^2 expansion splits the off-diagonal into a nonnegative two-edge sum plus (-a_ij)[24(L+mu)-16(a_ii+a_jj)]; kappa<=3 makes the latter nonnegative. In two dimensions trace(A)=L+mu gives the stronger all-kappa sign formula. The sharp 3D block family has an explicitly negative q_2(A) off-diagonal for every kappa>3. Independent exact rational expansion reproduced the displayed kappa=4 matrix and negative witness.
